thread:
Mariela (sales): Heads upPilot with AdopterCo goes live tomorrow AM. Dry run hit a few integration issues, can presales/eng triage quickly?
Tom R (presales): Summary from the dry run: intermittent SSE disconnects on long responses, tool-call JSON keys mismatch (snake_case vs camelCase), and SSO token exchange failing with `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`.
Priya N (eng): For SSE disconnects their proxy closes idle after ~30s when payloads are large. Our SDK keepalive defaults to 25s. Short-term fix: `client.setHeartbeat(10000)` (10s). We'll add that to sample app.
Mariela (sales): Is that something we can push to them or do we need infra changes?
Priya N (eng): Client-side only. I'll open a tiny PR with sample snippet and a config env var `SDK_KEEPALIVE=10s`.
Tom R (presales): JSON key mismatch is breaking their tool deserializer. They expect camelCase but some tool outputs are snake_case from a legacy adapter.
Priya N (eng): We can add a lightweight key-normalizer in the sample: `normalizeKeys(response, 'camelCase')`. Will include in PR.
Mariela (sales): SSO issue looks bigger. They use SAML-auth for the edge connector and the refresh path uses client_credential flow which their IdP rejects.
Tom R (presales): Error log: `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`. Their IdP requires a signed assertion for refresh.
Priya N (eng): Two options: (A) enable our session-exchange endpoint that accepts signed assertions (requires pilot entitlements/legal ok) or (B) provision a short-lived delegated key for the connector (security may object to long-lived keys).
Mariela (sales): Security likely prefers (A). How fast can we flip session-exchange for a pilot org?
Priya N (eng): We can enable within 24-48hrs once legal signs the pilot AUP. I'll file a JIRA: `pilot-adopter-session-exchange` and tag infra/security.
infra-bot: Deploy alert: `pilot-sampleapp` failed in dry run: EADDRINUSE on 8080. Suggest using ephemeral port or 8081.
Priya N (eng): I'll change sample app to default to port 0 (ephemeral) and add a fallback to 8081. PR will include heartbeat + normalizeKeys + port fix. Draft: `pr/901-pilot-adopter-fixes`.
Tom R (presales): Pricing question from them: they want clarity on streaming billing vs non-streaming and cost of function/tool calls during pilot.
Priya N (eng): Billing: streaming and non-streaming billed per token emitted; each function/tool call adds a small fixed metadata per-call fee (we'll give appendix). For pilot we can cap spend and enable token-level telemetry for them.
Mariela (sales): Action items: 1) I file JIRA and loop legal for AUP; 2) Priya pushes PR with sample fixes; 3) Tom updates runbook and pilot checklist; 4) infra redeploys sample app after PR. I'll DM legal & customer's SRE once PR lands.
Priya N (eng): Will ping here when PR is merged and when session-exchange is enabled. I'll stand by during tomorrow's run.
Mariela (sales): Thanks all :thumbsup: If anything goes sideways we'll rollback to previous image and demo using non-streaming calls.
Tom R (presales): Adding troubleshooting notes to runbook: heartbeat, normalizeKeys snippet, SSO fallback, EADDRINUSE quick fixes.
Mariela (sales): End of thread — will update after JIRA and PR merge.
